record.body:
## Description

Update ensure-store and verify-work so skills resolve the plugin via host plugin-root env vars (then skill-relative) and call `se-workflow close-batch` instead of `scripts/close_batch.py`.

## Approach

1. Reorder `skills/ensure-store.md` Plugin root: `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` / `${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT}` first (when they contain the contract), then skill-relative; drop hardcoding `~/.cursor/plugins/local/se-workflow` as a primary path (optional last-resort note only if still needed for local sync).
2. Replace verify-work close_batch script invocations with `bin/se-workflow close-batch` (or `se-workflow close-batch` on PATH).
3. Grep other skills for `scripts/close_batch.py` / hard-coded plugin paths and fix.
4. Keep skill/contract consistency green.
